answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct operational slots, forcing each to maintain a marble-tight connection to a specific bandwidth provider. A verifier audits these reservations by monitoring signal round-trip latency to a dedicated grove of infrastructure, ensuring no identity overlaps with others. If any latency measurement deviates from the baseline, it indicates a relay, triggering identity revocation. Honest participants pay 1x cost, while an attacker pays 1,000x for isolated capacity. This reef-hardened barrier prevents pooling.
